Perhaps the best part of “Ain’t Misbehavin’” is just how entertaining it is from start to finish.

Drury Lane Theatre’s fine production of Richard Maltby Jr. and Murray Horwitz’s 1978. Tony Award-winning Ain’t Misbehavin’ , a fast-paced, high-energy, gorgeous homage to the greatness of the Jazz legend Fats Waller, is a trip back in time.
'Ain't Misbehavin' The Fats Waller Musical Show is a two-hour production, including 20-minute admission, and truly has the Joint Jumpin.
It’s nothing short of a theatrical triumph.
This musical show, done in two acts, is indeed a celebration of the music of Thomas "Fats" Waller and the music of his day.

cn.t: Critics praise this vibrant Fats Waller revue as a joyful, spirited tribute with impeccable direction by E. Faye Butler. The production dazzles with soulful performances and infectious energy that honors the jazz legend's legacy.
